candidates.caveat: Ezekiel depicts God's own care for sheep; Quran describes a human messenger's compassion for believers. Different agent and imagery. Hebrew original, translation, and chronology need checking; may be too general for public association.

Both stress reliance on God, but Quran also contains monotheistic confession and Lord of the Throne. Psalm does not provide the same formula. Hebrew text and critical apparatus not checked; generic motif may not warrant public link.
